facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary endpoint, development suspended · Phase 3 · losmapimod in FSHD · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Phase 3 REACH trial evaluating losmapimod in patients with FSHD, did not achieve its primary endpoint of change from baseline in RSA with losmapimod compared to placebo.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not achieve its primary endpoint of change from baseline in RSA with losmapimod compared to placebo
evidence.safety: there were no treatment-related serious adverse events in participants receiving losmapimod.
evidence.program_discontinued: In light of these results, we plan to suspend the losmapimod program in FSHD.
